messages:
maria_cs: FYI — customer reported a codegen regression after yesterday's v2 rollout. Failing builds, generated JS missing init calls. Pasting customer report below.

maria_cs (customer quote): "After the update our codegen outputs compile errors. Init call is missing and some imports are dropped. CI fails with TS2304. Example attached."

maria_cs: attach log:
```
Error: src/setup.ts:5:10 - error TS2304: Cannot find name 'clientConfig'.
5 const client = new Client(clientConfig);
         ~~~~~~
Generated code snippet:
export function makeApp() {
  const client = new Client();
  // missing await initService();
  return client;
}
```

jonah_eng: which model id + model version did they call? need prompt, sampling, and request_id

maria_cs: they used our hosted endpoint via customer token. request_id=req_78a9f3c2, model=code-dex-v2, temp=0.2, top_p=0.95. Prompt is short: "generate typescript setup for sdk client with init and config". CI repro link: https://acme.ci/build/12345 (customer-provided)

sam_ml: could be a behavior change from the rollout — style drift or hallucinated omission. I've seen similar when model variant gets a more concise completion. Check rollout map: maybe default model alias was pointed to code-dex-v2-small accidentally.

jonah_eng: I'll try to repro locally using their prompt and model alias + request_id. If I can reproduce I'll capture exact tokens and ngrams to see where init call got dropped.

maria_cs: severity = blocking for their CI (30% of generated files fail). Customer asking for temp rollback if we can't fix quickly. They're on a paid Dedicated plan.

tess_pm: escalate to SRE/Platform and Product. @jonah_eng @sam_ml prioritize. Also create internal ticket and notify account team.

deploy-bot: prod rollout 'code-dex-v2' -> 'code-dex-v2.1' completed at 2026-03-16T22:18:03Z by ci/cd

jonah_eng: noted. I'll run a small script now. If repro, propose immediate routing rule to map the customer's org to previous model variant for safety.

maria_cs: here's a curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -d '{"model":"code-dex-v2","prompt":"generate typescript setup for sdk client with init and config","max_tokens":240,"temperature":0.2}'
```

sam_ml: also ask for a sample failing generated file from their repo (small) — will run our eval harness to compare code-dex-v2 vs previous variant.

maria_cs: uploaded snippet to the ticket: /internal/attachments/req_78a9f3c2/setup-fail.ts

jonah_eng: I'll update thread when I have a repro. If reproducible, plan: 1) temporary routing for org acme -> code-dex-v1; 2) capture eval set; 3) roll patch to generate explicit init patterns or add a postprocessing check that inserts init call when missing.

tess_pm: add postmortem label and schedule 1-hour war room if rollback needed. @accounts to inform customer.

maria_cs: thanks all — customer asked for ETA in 2 hours. tagging as P0. :thumbsup:
